verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line on the Iceberg tables page stating "Time travel for historical data access in BigQuery." That documents some historical-query capability, but only thinly and in the Iceberg-table context. Nothing in the pack covers restoring dropped or corrupted tables. Missing for 10: documentation of querying standard tables as of a past timestamp, restoring dropped or corrupted tables from history, details of the retention window, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can time-travel — query data as of a past point and restore dropped or corrupted tables from history

citations.quote: Time travel for historical data access in BigQuery.
